title: New method version
purpose: Create a separate active version with the predecessor’s method code while preserving work that used it.
summary: Create a new version of a method with the same code, while work that used the old version keeps it. Only admins can create versions.

tasks.title: Create the new version
steps: Enter the new version text and check the prefilled title and references.
Leave the active tests copied, or uncheck the copy if the new version needs different tests.
Decide whether to retire the previous version for new work.
Give the [[Reason for the new version]] and select [[Create version]].

good_to_know: Copying brings over analyte, matrix, unit and default limit only. QC, holding, preservation and preparation rules must be set up for the new version separately.
If you don't retire the previous version, both stay active and receipt can offer both.
Existing work keeps the old version either way.

items.label: Version
items.description: Required new revision/edition/year text, up to 40 characters. Code/version must not already exist, ignoring case.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required, up to 200 characters; prefilled from the predecessor and editable.

items.label: Source or SOP reference
items.description: Optional; prefilled from the predecessor and editable.

items.label: Reference source
items.description: Optional; prefilled from the predecessor and editable. Not recorded leaves it blank. Descriptor only: not printed on reports.

items.label: Technique
items.description: Optional; prefilled from the predecessor and editable. Not recorded leaves it blank. Descriptor only: not printed on reports.

items.label: Copy the active tests
items.description: Checked initially; label gives the active-test count. Copies analyte, matrix, unit and default limit into active new definitions. Inactive definitions and QC, holding, preservation and preparation rules are not copied; configure applicable rules for the new version separately.

items.label: Retire the previous version
items.description: Unchecked initially. Check to inactivate the predecessor for new work. If unchecked, both versions can stay active and receipt can offer both. Existing work keeps the old version either way.

items.label: Reason for the new version
items.description: Required reason stored with creation, copied definitions and optional retirement.

items.label: Based on
items.description: Predecessor title and dependency facts, including active/all test counts.

items.label: Create version
items.description: Administrators create the new version, optional copies and retirement together, then open its edit form. Existing predecessor fields and definitions remain intact.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Methods without creating a version.
